description: Reviewed Rust reference changes made after the pinned baseline. The inventory gate accepts working-source drift only for these exact file hashes; every other Rust source must still match the baseline byte for byte.
review: 2026-10-31 independent read-only review of Rust, scripts and docs changes; native lanes updated to mirror each behavior change.

amendments.reason: Reject duplicate child segments and duplicate selected metadata fields as incomplete or invalid inspection output.
watch_status field order (counters before rows) and the effect.labels.debugger_affected label key.
Treat incomplete schema metadata as partial, keep Equals triggers from firing on inspector errors, and add allocation-free protocol status summaries.

Checkpoint sequence includes sequence_origin; policy provenance is checked before replay; declared-policy branches from unrestricted or partially recorded parents are rejected. Live-capture parents, which record no simulation policy, impose none on a branch.
Test-only: persisted campaign witness controls for Swift-produced and self-model traces; no library behavior change.
Bound consecutive already-seen simplifier hints per simpler_inputs iterator; an endless hint stream ends with attempt_limit, finite streams are unchanged.
Check runtime observation sequence overflow (including sequence origin) before the model metadata callback.
Read frames with a bounded loop that rejects readers reporting more bytes than requested instead of panicking in read_exact.
